deck.name: Spanish verbs — A2
deck.description: Present and preterite forms of common verbs.

cards.explanation: Tener is irregular in the yo form.

cards.prompt: Which verbs share their preterite forms?
cards.explanation: Fui, fuiste, fue… means both "I went" and "I was".

cards.prompt: Estar is used for permanent traits.
cards.explanation: Permanent traits take ser; states and locations take estar.

cards.prompt: Tener is regular in the preterite.

cards.explanation: The c turns into z to keep the sound.
